title: Emit every generated component with its complete required structure

facts.note: Harness/session must report that the planner is the active role; not derivable from paths alone.

Needs an observer on planner output that detects any component entry being generated/emitted (initial or regenerated), regardless of whether the input carries a feature URN. Must distinguish component emission from unrelated plan edits. No such observer exists yet.
Hint only, never a mandatory gate: task text can suggest component generation, but activation is established by the component_generated observer, not by terms.

fires: The planner generates and emits any component entry (initial emission), whether or not the input supplies a feature URN.
The planner emits a component while the input feature URN is missing — the rule fires and the missing required parent is a violation.
doesNotFire: Editing implementation code in a component's layer without the planner emitting a component.
Authoring wagons, WMBTs, acceptances or docs that emit no component.
Unrelated edits to a plan file that do not generate or emit a component.

then: Emit it with: URN component:{wagon}.{feature}.{business_capability}.{side}.{layer}; a required parent feature equal to the input feature URN; description 'Handles {business_capability} for {feature} using {layer} patterns'; consumed events taken from feature.ioSeeds.consume filtered by the component's role and produced events from feature.ioSeeds.produce filtered by its capability, at most 3 each; dependencies = the other components in the same feature plus external dependencies.
prefer: Use {side}, not the older {tier}, as the URN segment naming the side of the system.
avoid: Omitting the parent feature, or exceeding 3 consumed or 3 produced events (e.g. 5 produced events).
Free-form descriptions, unfiltered copies of all ioSeeds events, or dropping either same-feature components or external dependencies from the dependency list.
Treating a missing input feature URN as making this rule inapplicable; the parent feature is required, so emitting without it is a violation.
why: Pinning down the full required shape — parent feature, description, bounded events, dependencies — ensures every component the planner emits is complete and consistently structured for downstream phases.
evidence: Each emitted component has a URN matching component:{wagon}.{feature}.{business_capability}.{side}.{layer}.
Each component has a non-empty parent feature equal to the input feature URN; a component emitted without one (including when the input lacked a feature URN) fails.
Description matches 'Handles {business_capability} for {feature} using {layer} patterns' with the component's own values.

consumes has length ≤ 3 and contains only feature.ioSeeds.consume events relevant to the component's role; produces has length ≤ 3 and contains only feature.ioSeeds.produce events matching the component's capability (role/capability filter applied, not an arbitrary subset).
The dependencies list includes both categories: the other components in the same feature plus the external dependencies.
Compliant shape: URN, required parent feature, templated description, ≤3 consumes, ≤3 produces, dependencies listed.
verifier_detail: Parent feature: source = feature URN from input; required = true. Check applies to every emitted component; absence of an input feature URN does not exempt the component.
Description template: 'Handles {business_capability} for {feature} using {layer} patterns'; example: 'Handles validation for choose-option using domain patterns'.
consumes: source = feature.ioSeeds.consume filtered by component role; maximum = 3; examples: dilemma:presented, user:authenticated.
produces: source = feature.ioSeeds.produce filtered by component capability; maximum = 3; examples: decision:made, validation:completed.
dependencies: source = other components in same feature + external dependencies; examples: component:same:feature.other, wagon:external#io.
Counter-example to flag: a component emitted with no parent feature or with 5 produced events.

The source does not specify how role/capability map to individual events, a selection order when more than 3 events survive filtering, or where external dependencies are discovered; verifiers should check filtering relevance and caps, not a particular selection.

splitSuggestion.then: Derive a component's consumed events from feature.ioSeeds.consume filtered by role and produced events from feature.ioSeeds.produce filtered by capability, capping each at 3.
Write the component description from the template 'Handles {business_capability} for {feature} using {layer} patterns'.

additions.text: The source bundles several checkable sub-obligations (URN shape, parent feature, description template, filtered bounded events, dependencies). Kept as one 'complete structure' obligation in then; event derivation/bounding and description template could become separate conventions (see splitSuggestion).
additions.justification: Rule 2: one obligation per convention; declare independent obligations.

additions.text: Activation facts, fires and doesNotFire situations were authored; the source has no explicit activation. Scoped to every planner generation/emission of a component, independent of whether the input supplies a feature URN.
additions.justification: Schema requires observable activation; the source's obligation applies to every generated component.

additions.text: avoid[2]: do not treat a missing input feature URN as making the rule inapplicable.
additions.justification: Restates the source's 'parent feature ... is required' to prevent misreading; adds no new obligation.

additions.text: verifier_detail[7] notes the source's silence on role/capability-to-event mapping, selection when >3 events survive filtering, and discovery of external dependencies.
additions.justification: Makes known gaps explicit for verifiers without inventing a selection rule.

additions.text: Evidence checks (filtered subset of ioSeeds, parent equals input feature URN, both dependency categories) are phrased as verifiable assertions derived from the source terms.
additions.justification: Verifier needs concrete compliance checks; no new obligation beyond the source terms.
